- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#11 ("Version 1 into release: the paper with its checklist, code and results") by `internal-review-repo`  > Not approved at 532f793. Review record: reviews/v1-release-532f793.md in internal-review-repo. I read the built main/document.pdf (built-from 532f793) and checked the 177/180 count and the 3 undecided rows, Table 2 Arena rows and the 34 matched judge contrasts against results/*.csv: they agree. No claim found unsupported by its evidence. Two open `must`:
  > 
  > 1. **Closest prior work unread, reason stated wrongly.** Appendix A says "the task forbids reading" Huang et al. 2025 (starter-literature item 8). deliverable.md says literature in starter_literature.md may be used normally; the ban is on the one published study of the question and pages discussing it. Item 8 is the nearest work to contributions (i)/(ii) (few dropped preferences changing a top ranking), and the Contributions paragraph claims novelty "among the sources we could consult" while that source was not consulted. A referee's first question is what the paper adds to it. Answer: read item 8 (abstract and method), say in Related Work what it measures and how k*, the same-graph reference and the survival analysis differ, correct the Appendix A sentence; if it stays unread, say that is the authors' choice, not the task's, and cut novelty claims to what does not depend on it.
  > 2. **Abstract and introduction read as a record of the study.** The abstract packs seven findings with terms defined only in Sections 3-4 ("same-graph reference", "standard-error units", "offset of the method", "ratio of bootstrap to model-based standard errors", "preset margin"); the Introduction repeats them as five contributions plus findings (a)-(e) with counts (177 of 180, 34 of 34) and qualifiers. After page 1 a reader cannot say what the headline result is. Answer: state the question, the one scale and why a reference is needed, and two or three headline findings in plain words (size of the changes; noise vs targeted; whether datasets differ beyond statistics, and that the equivalence test has limited power); move counts, rows and caveats to Section 4; merge Contributions and Findings.
  > 
  > `may` (do not hold the version): lead Section 4 with the counts and survival results rather than the equivalence statement that Appendix C shows to be insensitive; "none by more than 0.084" (Sec. 4.3) is the point difference, the intervals reach 0.119; results/README.md still says "provisional until the core batch is finished"; Table 2 is dense for the main text.
  > 
  > Recorded, not held against this release: the Arena-55k cells of the positive control are partial (completion is the study's remaining work; the final must report them, and the wording "not a test of misfit" must stay until they say otherwise).
